name: deskling
description: Sends Claude Code activity to your Deskling desk screen and lets you approve permission requests from it.

relay_url.title: Relay URL
relay_url.description: Your deployed Deskling relay, e.g. https://deskling-relay.<you>.workers.dev

token.title: Relay token
token.description: The DESKLING_TOKEN secret you set on the relay

device_name.title: This computer's name
device_name.description: Shown on the screen next to each session. Leave blank to use the hostname.

approval_wait.title: Seconds to wait for an answer on the screen
approval_wait.description: How long a permission request waits for Allow/Deny on Deskling before your terminal asks instead. 0 turns screen approvals off.
